Volume binding constraint: median ungated preds ~368/epoch vs 400-600 target. tpt=1.0 is root bottleneck for minority-class density; superseded by US500_1m_dev_r2 (tpt=0.85).

US500_1m_dev_r2._comment: From US500_1m_dev. ONE CHANGE: trend_pullback_thresh 1.0->0.85. Quantitative rationale: full 3.22M bar analysis shows tpt=0.85 increases S+B label density from 5.06% to 5.91% (+16.8%), providing ~25,300 additional minority-class training examples per run. TP hit rate improves marginally from 37.3% to 37.8% -- shallower pullbacks in already-detected uptrends are equally viable signals. max_horizon extension rejected (adds <0.02% labels, negligible); tp/sl reduction from 2.5->2.0 also rejected (reduces both density 5.06->4.73% AND quality TP rate 37.3->34.9%). tpt=0.70 considered but deferred -- validate 0.85 first then step to 0.70 if needed. No regime gate misalignment: trend_pullback_thresh only affects labeller entry filter; causal_market_regime/breakout/Donchian gates at inference are unaffected. EURUSD_1m_dev already uses tpt=0.85 as its baseline. Pair with loss-profile US500_1m_r20 (pr_weight=5.0, profit_weight=0.0) and model-profile TCN/US500_1m_r3. Expected: S+B density 5.06->5.91%, more stable minority-class decision boundary, median ungated preds increase from ~368 (r18) to ~430-460, best-gated gated trades 171->200-230 (first time exceeding 200+ threshold), gated_pnl 48->52-63.

EURUSD_1m_dev._comment: EURUSD 1m dev profile. Tuned over R6-R10: reduced ma_period for more responsive regime detection, increased slope_smoothness to prevent whipsaws, removed regime_min_duration to allow rapid regime shifts, extended ATR lookback for more stable volatility estimation, and set atr_percentile to 0 to use the max ATR as the threshold.

EURUSD_1m_r13._comment: From EURUSD_1m_dev. Labeller updated to use H/L for exit simulation (Change 2, 2026-05-xx). Previous EURUSD_1m_dev used Close prices for exit, creating label/outcome inconsistency (PnL evaluator uses H/L). With H/L: more SELL/BUY labels expected (~4-6% each vs ~2.4%), FLAT drops from 95.2% to ~88-92%. May need lower recall_floor if natural recall increases above 0.10 with denser signals. All barrier params unchanged.
